intro.text: A listener and head of the First-Rhythm family.

items.text: For a long time Sharefel sang the old songs of the listeners, hoping to rediscover warform.

Around 1166 his family conquered one of the eight listener cities on the Shattered Plains, and the defeated family gave up the city's Shardplate and Shardblade to him. He lived in a strong, well-kept hut near the city's drums.

When Eshonai and others first took warform, Venli had them report to Sharefel at once, as another family had come to try to win the city. Pleased, he said he would take the form himself, but felt it was time for a new Shardbearer. To avoid a fight over his Shards, Eshonai asked him to wear the Plate when they met the rival family; he agreed, though he insisted he would not attack them.

appearance.text: An older malen with mostly black skin patterns; he speaks softly, often to the Rhythm of the Lost.

personality.text: He commands great respect in his family, and keeps to the listener tradition of using Shards only to hunt greatshells.
